status: Descriptive design data for static concepts; not a runtime theme or component API.

space.unit: CSS-pixel-equivalent; adapt to native units and user scaling

motion.reducedMotion: Remove decorative motion; preserve stable progress and status information.

contrast.method: Standard sRGB relative luminance for opaque solid colors; displayed ratios round to two decimals.
contrast.foregroundOnAccent: Below 4.5:1 before rounding; do not use for normal text requiring 4.5:1.
